summary: Tom Austin is the mate of the Duncan and plays a significant role in the journey with Lord Glenarvan. He is a confident and experienced sailor who is loyal to Glenarvan and works closely with other characters, including Paganel and Major MacNabb. Throughout the journey, Tom Austin is involved in various events, including the discovery of a bottle in a shark's stomach and encountering a storm in the Pampas.
